correctness.rationale: Exact Gaussian-conditioned posterior integrated variance is expressed as a rational function. Its dependence on the midpoint is strictly monotone through a cosh factor. Strict boundary derivative inequalities prove interior distinct sites for every positive rate/noise. Uniform derivative signs and concavity near collision prove high-noise uniqueness; IFT and a second-order Taylor gain yield the sharp coefficients. The standalone checker passes symbolic and numerical supplementary tests; no finite sample is substituted for an all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: Two noisy measurements of an OU trajectory are a natural finite sensor placement question. The strict noncollocation theorem for all positive noise and explicit high-noise midpoint separation plus cubic regret provide a structural design boundary and quantitative replication cost not supplied by merely evaluating an objective at prespecified sites.
